findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is an endpoint pointcloud with a detached Hungarian endpoint mean squared distance and native endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The observed support is the learning window [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score times at 0.01 spacing, and the label semantics are recorded affinities removed with an equal score prior; therefore no decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied and last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Curve support is restricted to 24 selected features under an explicit selection rule requiring absolute integrated z at least 0.1, batch direction fraction at least 0.857, exclusion of a scale floor and q below 0.05, with a fidelity rule of relative RMSE at most 0.35, quiet-node large-fit fraction at most 0.1 and zero strong sign conflicts; this is a selection-enrichment criterion, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed window show sign changes and rate reversals rather than a constant rule: for example landmark_00_soft_mass has four sign changes with a positive first rate z and a negative last rate z, and landmark_00_local_dx has six sign changes with a negative first rate z and a positive last rate z, both with polynomial_accepted false and extrapolation_allowed false.

Several local coordinate contrasts carry many strong sign conflicts and high relative node RMSE, such as landmark_00_local_cxy with nine sign changes, fourteen strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE about 0.87, and landmark_00_local_dy with six sign changes and relative node RMSE about 0.67; these are not validated as stable time-conditioned rules.

Some features show low relative node RMSE with few sign conflicts, such as landmark_00_soft_mass at about 0.29 relative node RMSE with one strong sign conflict and landmark_00_local_cyy at about 0.41 with one strong sign conflict, so fit fidelity and conflict counts, not point estimates alone, separate candidate coordinate hypotheses.

hypotheses.falsifier: No difference in the observed-node contrast response between the constant and time-conditioned rule, or a sign pattern inconsistent with the delivered continuous trend.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass contrast evaluated at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned regional attention rule keyed to the observed-node contrast of landmark_00_soft_mass, which changes sign within the observed window, would produce a different coordinate response than a constant static regional rule.

hypotheses.falsifier: A validated fit with zero strong sign conflicts and relative node RMSE within the fidelity rule for the same feature.
hypotheses.observable: strong sign conflict count and relative node RMSE per feature
hypotheses.statement: Local coordinate contrasts with many strong sign conflicts and high relative node RMSE, such as landmark_00_local_cxy and landmark_00_local_dy, should not be promoted to a time-conditioned reward because their observed-node fits are not validated.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record, survival and terminal-rescoring semantics cannot be equated with final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to this role, so no causal selection effect, atom velocity or neural-module causation is claimed.

Uncertainty, multiplicity-adjusted support and coverage tables were not read in this turn, so the ranking-versus-point-estimate comparison and the joint-versus-marginal coupling comparison remain unsupported here.
The curve fidelity audit container was delivered only as a summary; its per-feature numeric contents were not read.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed.
